files.adaptation: Seeded PRNG and struck-note partial synthesis ported into lib/audio.mjs; oscillator evaluation uses Math.sin.
Narration span bridging and attack/release ducking adapted into lib/audio.mjs; parameters simplified, no presence-band carving.
The full MIT notice is retained in the lib/audio.mjs header and in this record.

originalImplementation: lib/audio.mjs: project-scene score orchestration, event synthesis, strict decode, complete source/config/code cache hashing, WAV writer
lib/timeline.mjs: common word anchor clock, precision metadata, SRT generation
lib/voice.mjs: content-addressed import and explicitly configured voice providers
scope: A deliberately small integrated DSP subset, not the complete upstream sound/score system. No upstream source is modified.
